blocks.text: Let's look at this one. Which of these are terms of six minus four a squared plus a minus two a b? Choose all that apply.
blocks.display: Select all the terms of 6 − 4a^2 + a − 2ab.

blocks.text: Six. It is the first piece, a constant term. Right.
Negative four a squared. The minus sign belongs to the term after it. Right.
Four a squared leaves out the minus sign. The term is negative four a squared. Not a term of this expression.
a. A letter on its own is a term, with a hidden coefficient of one. Right.
Negative two a b. The minus sign belongs to the term. Right.
Two a b leaves out the minus sign. The term is negative two a b. Not a term of this expression.
Four of them are terms: six, negative four a squared, a, and negative two a b. Each term keeps the sign in front of it, and a letter on its own is a term with a hidden coefficient of one.
